headline_marked: Anthropic to [[develop its own drugs]] with AI
headline: Anthropic to develop its own drugs with AI
summary: Anthropic announces plans to develop drugs for neglected diseases using AI
details: Anthropic, a leading AI company, has announced plans to develop its own drugs using artificial intelligence. The company aims to focus on discovering treatments for 'neglected' diseases.

Anthropic's move is one of the most direct public attempts by a major frontier AI company to actually develop drugs itself. The company will use its AI models to search across vast chemical and biological possibilities and help researchers make connections that would be difficult or slow to find otherwise.

Experts say that while AI is undoubtedly changing drug development, the field is 'a long way off' from an AI-designed drug being approved by regulators for human use. Human input and supervision will be required throughout the drug discovery process.
caption:
Can AI revolutionize drug development? Anthropic thinks so.

Anthropic, a leading AI company, has announced plans to develop its own drugs using artificial intelligence. The company aims to focus on discovering treatments for 'neglected' diseases.

Anthropic's move is one of the most direct public attempts by a major frontier AI company to actually develop drugs itself. The company will use its AI models to search across vast chemical and biological possibilities and help researchers make connections that would be difficult or slow to find otherwise.

Experts say that while AI is undoubtedly changing drug development, the field is 'a long way off' from an AI-designed drug being approved by regulators for human use. Human input and supervision will be required throughout the drug discovery process.
